Every update_booking/book tool call carried a literal policy_accepted=false argument (draft-state default), yet no policy gate ever fired — confirms the actual gate reads Customer.policy_accepted_at from the DB rather than this per-call draft field, matching the seeded 'already accepted' precondition.
